components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action — espresso fill, white text. The everyday working button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--espresso, #2a1c16); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 38px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d2a22; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The committing action — save payment, print statement. At most one per screen (The One Nib Rule).
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: var(--gold, #c9a227); color: #1c1410; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 38px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #dbb93f; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-gold:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel and utility actions — white fill, hairline border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1c1410); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4d5c4); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 38px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper, #f6efe4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Cash-direction vocabulary pill — pay/receive shown; default cream/coffee. The label always says the word.
components.html: Black Pepper To pay ₹4,500 To receive ₹1,200
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #efe3d2; color: var(--coffee, #7a3e1d); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-pay { background: #fee2e2; color: var(--pay, #8a2e1a); } .ds-tag-receive { background: #d1fae5; color: var(--receive, #1d5c4a); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The working surface — cream on paper, hairline border, single ambient shadow, uppercase label title.
components.html:
Outstanding (cash)

₹12,400

They owe us (to receive)
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #fffaf3); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4d5c4); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(28,20,16,0.08); font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1c1410); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--muted, #7a6556); } .ds-card-metric { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; margin: 0; } .ds-card-note { color: var(--muted, #7a6556); font-size: 13px; margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: White field with hairline stroke under a muted 13px label; coffee border + gold ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #7a6556); font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink, #1c1410); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4d5c4); background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; caret-color: var(--coffee, #7a3e1d); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--coffee, #7a3e1d); outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar link — warm sand text in a pill; active gets paper tint, 3px gold inset, aria-current.
components.html: PaymentsCash & Bank
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--espresso, #2a1c16), #1a110e 70%); padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-nav-link { color: #d8c4b2; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255,250,243,0.08); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link.active { background: rgba(255,250,243,0.08); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--gold, #c9a227); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Top-right outcome notice — success/info fade in 4s; errors persist with a dismiss button.
components.html:
Payment recorded
Rate is required when pricing quantity
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(28,20,16,0.18); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-toast-success { background: var(--ok, #2f6b3a); } .ds-toast-error { background: var(--danger, #9f1239); } .ds-toast-close { background: none; border: none; color: inherit; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-toast-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

components.name: Modal
components.description: The single dialog system — centered card on ink scrim, Fraunces title, focus trapped, Esc closes.
components.html:
Record Repayment

Repaying Kollenkode Estate · Balance: ₹8,200
components.css: .ds-modal-bg { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(28,20,16,0.45); display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 20px; } .ds-modal { position: relative; width: min(640px, 100%); background: var(--card, #fffaf3); border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-modal-note { color: var(--muted, #7a6556); font-size: 13px; margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-modal-x { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 12px; background: none; border: none; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted, #7a6556); padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-modal-x:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c1410); background: rgba(28,20,16,0.06); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is the trader's bound ledger at the weighbridge: ink on paper, kept with a gold-nib pen. Warm espresso ink, cream paper surfaces, and one precious metal — gold — used the way a nib touches the page: rarely, and only where the hand commits an action. It is an Operate-mode system: scanability, one left axis, and honest numbers outrank expression, and the brand lives in precise details — the gold inset on the active nav line, tabular figures in money columns, the pepper tag beside the coffee one.

Density is working-desk density: forms stacked in one rhythm, tables flush with their cards, no decorative chrome. Components feel tactile and confident — solid fills, real borders, buttons you can press one-handed at a weighbridge. Printed output (party statements, the formal Bill of Supply) is the same identity on white: Fraunces headings, espresso rules, paper-tinted table headers — never foreign office grays.
keyCharacteristics: Warm product-derived palette (coffee, pepper, gold) on paper tints — no cold grays anywhere, including print
Fraunces serif for display and figures of account; Figtree for everything functional
One spacing scale (4–32px) and one left axis per card: titles, table cells, and body copy align
Cash-basis vocabulary rendered as tag pills: pay/receive, expense/income, settled/pending
Depth is a single soft ambient shadow on cards; everything else is flat paper

rules.name: The One Nib Rule
rules.body: Gold appears at most once per view as an action (the committing button) plus once as wayfinding (the active-nav inset). If two gold buttons compete on one screen, one of them is lying about being final — demote it to espresso or secondary.

rules.name: The No Foreign Grays Rule
rules.body: Error, info, and neutral tints are derived from the palette (rose from danger, cream from card), never from office grays. Printed documents keep the same rule: espresso rules and paper-tinted headers, not black-and-gray.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Fraunces never sets form controls, buttons, or table body text; Figtree never sets page titles or metrics. If a third voice appears (Helvetica, system display faces), it is a bug — print documents included.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: The sidebar and printed sheets never cast shadows. Ink sits on paper; it does not hover above it.

dos: Do space with the scale tokens (4/8/12/16/24/32) and let .main children inherit their 16px separation from CSS.
Do render money right-aligned in tabular numerals (.num) and format through format.ts (money, kg, en-IN).
Do use the tag vocabulary for direction of money — pay/receive — with the word in the pill, never color alone.
Do give new dialogs to openModal with an h3.modal-title, and new tables scope="col" headers inside .table-wrap.
Do keep printed output on the shared print system — Fraunces letterhead, espresso rules, paper tints.
Do disable the submit button while a save is in flight, and toast the outcome (success short, error persistent).
donts: Don't introduce inline style attributes — a missing class is a stylesheet gap, not a license.
Don't spend gold on more than one action per screen, or on anything that doesn't commit something.
Don't use foreign grays, Helvetica, or system display faces — on screen or on paper.
Don't build a second modal, print, or toast system; extend the existing one.
Don't leave interactive targets under 36px on mobile, or inputs under 16px at phone width.
Don't show raw IDs, enum constants, or sign ambiguity to users — names, words, and Dr/Cr conventions only.
